title: Immune gene expression across blood, cerebrospinal fluid and nerve in inflammatory neuropathies
description: Public aggregate materials for manuscript v41. Includes the revised manuscript, five main figures, four supplementary figures, three tables, a 49 worksheet workbook, methods, scripts and source access records. Corrects CSF synthesis and adds exploratory Fc sensitivity analyses and annotation reaggregation. The Fc association attenuates with broader multiplicity correction and composition adjustment. No independent external validation or functional experiment was completed. Individual donor intermediates and the private author archive are excluded. Code is MIT licensed. Project derived data and figures are CC BY 4.0. External source materials retain their original terms.
